en:
What's up? I don't think there's 
anything for us to talk about.
No? Well...

<CLT=cltMIND>I know that Ryoma hasn't lost his
passion for tennis.

<CLT=cltMIND>After listening to the way he talks about his
old tennis friends, I'm sure of it.

<CLT=cltMIND>Maybe I can help Ryoma
accept his feelings!
Hey, what's the matter?

Ah, I was just thinking about how fun your
tennis stories are. I'd like to hear more.

You actually enjoyed those...? 
Hmph, what a strange guy.

We talked about my tennis friends. 
What else did you want to hear?

Ah, maybe...
you have some stories about your rivals?
Hmph, my rivals.

I don't know if I'd call them that, 
but there were some people...

Do you remember the captain I 
talked about last time?
The guy who used that "zone" technique?
There was a guy who beat him.

What!?
His zone was broken?
Yeah...

He used a technique called Insight 
to see his opponent's weaknesses.

He made full use of this technique 
to beat his opponents down...

He was feared as the 
King of the courts.
<CLT=cltMIND>King...?

There were others with crazy nicknames 
like Child of God and Emperor...

Child of God? Emperor?
There are tennis players like that...?

Yeah, the Child of God's aura
was a real pain.

All five of my senses were stolen...
In the end, I couldn't even stand.
Your senses were stolen!?

The Emperor's special technique was 
called <CLT=cltSTRONG>Fu Rin Ka Zan<CLT=cltNORMAL>. I faced it once...

But then he unsealed its true power 
and it became <CLT=cltSTRONG>Fu Rin Ka In Zan Rai<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

<CLT=cltMIND>You need all those secret techniques...
for tennis?

We'd all give everything we had...
Being defeated only made us stronger.
This is beyond the realm of tennis
It must have been a lot of fun!
I'd love to watch a match someday
Are you unsure of something?

That was the type of 
world I lived in.

This is beyond the realm of tennis...
How did you get your senses back!?

Hmph...it's foolish to assume your 
common sense applies everywhere...

This is a good example, right? It's 
common sense to me, but not to you.
<CLT=cltMIND>I suppose so...
It must have been a lot of fun!
Why do you think that...?

Well, because...you looked like you were
having a lot of fun telling that story...

Hmph, you're right. 
I can't say it was boring...
But...that's an old story...
I'd love to watch a match someday.

You're telling me to play again?
Impossible.

N-No, ah, well, I would love to watch you
play, but I could watch other players too...

Then when we get out of here, I'll 
see if I can get you into a match.

But just so you know,
I won't come with you.
Well...that's enough.

If I talk anymore, I'll start to 
remember things best forgotten...

What am I saying? Hmph, it's not 
like me to get so emotional.
Anyway, see ya...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Ryoma's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.

<CLT=cltMIND>I watched Ryoma walk away, dejected,
and returned to my room.
